note.title: fuzzing de parametros & api discovery
note.intro: descobrir parametros aceitos, endpoints de api escondidos, e metodos http alternativos. onde achar input escondido que as ferramentas de dir fuzzing nao pegam.
commands:
# arjun (o melhor, analisa resposta)
arjun -u https://alvo.com/page -o arjun_results.json
arjun -u https://alvo.com/page -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/burp-parameter-names.txt -t 20

# paramspider (crawler + fuzzer de parametros)
paramspider -d alvo.com -o paramspider_results/

# x8 (rust, muito rapido)
x8 -u https://alvo.com/page -w params.txt -o x8_results.txt

# ffuf parametro GET
ffuf -u "https://alvo.com/page?FUZZ=test" -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/burp-parameter-names.txt -mc all -ac

# ffuf parametro POST
ffuf -u "https://alvo.com/api/login" -X POST -d "FUZZ=test" -w params.txt -mc all -ac -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"

# ffuf parametro JSON
ffuf -u "https://alvo.com/api/user" -X POST -d '{"FUZZ":"test"}' -w params.txt -mc all -ac -H "Content-Type: application/json"

cat params.txt | while read url; do
  base=$(echo "$url" | sed 's/=.*/=FUZZ/')
  ffuf -u "$base" -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/burp-parameter-names.txt \
    -mc 200,301,302,403 -ac -t 30 -of csv -o param_bruteforce.csv
done

# testar todos os metodos http
methods=(GET POST PUT DELETE PATCH OPTIONS HEAD TRACE)
for m in "${methods[@]}"; do
  code=$(curl -X "$m" https://alvo.com/api/user -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}")
  echo "$m -> $code"
done

# ffuf com wordlist de metodos
ffuf -u https://alvo.com/api/user -X FUZZ -w <(echo -e "GET\nPOST\nPUT\nDELETE\nPATCH\nOPTIONS\nHEAD\nTRACE") -mc all -ac

# api so aceita json? tenta form-urlencoded, xml
curl -X POST https://alvo.com/api/login -d 'user=admin&pass=test' -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
curl -X POST https://alvo.com/api/login -d '{"user":"admin","pass":"test"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"
curl -X POST https://alvo.com/api/login -d '<user>admin</user><pass>test</pass>' -H "Content-Type: application/xml"

# trocar content-type pode bypassar validacao e habilitar xxe ou mass assignment

for sub in $(cat live_subs.txt); do for doc in swagger.json swagger.yaml openapi.json api-docs api/docs api/v1/docs api/swagger; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://$sub/$doc") | "$code" == "301" && echo "[+] https://$sub/$doc ($code)" done done

# endpoints comuns de graphql for sub in $(cat live_subs.txt); do # testar se graphql existe code=$(curl -s "https://$sub/graphql" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"{__schema{types{name}}}"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}") "$code" == "200" && echo "[+] graphql em https://$sub/graphql" # introspection curl -s "https://$sub/graphql" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"query":"{__schema { types { name fields { name type { name kind } } } } }"}' | jq 2>/dev/null done # graphw00f (fingerprinter de graphql) graphw00f -t https://alvo.com/graphql

curl -s https://alvo.com/robots.txt
curl -s https://alvo.com/sitemap.xml | grep -oP 'https?://[^<]+' | sort -u > sitemap_urls.txt

# extrair palavras do proprio site
cewl https://alvo.com -w custom_words.txt -d 3 -m 4

# extrair nomes de funcoes js
cat js_files.txt | while read url; do
  curl -s "$url" | grep -oP '(var|let|const|function)\s+\K\w+' | sort -u
done > js_function_names.txt

# extrair paths relativos dos js
cat js_files.txt | while read url; do
  curl -s "$url" | grep -oP '["\x27](/[^"\x27]+)["\x27]' | tr -d '"'\'' | sort -u
done > js_paths.txt

# usar wordlists custom no ffuf
ffuf -u "https://alvo.com/FUZZ" -w custom_words.txt -mc 200,301,302,403 -ac

cat interesting_routes.txt | while read url; do
  # headers de bypass
  curl -s "$url" -H "X-Original-URL: /admin" -o /dev/null -w "$url -> %{http_code}\n"
  curl -s "$url" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1" -o /dev/null -w "$url XFF -> %{http_code}\n"

  # verb tampering
  curl -s -X POST "$url" -o /dev/null -w "$url POST -> %{http_code}\n"
  curl -s -X PUT "$url" -o /dev/null -w "$url PUT -> %{http_code}\n"

  # override method header
  curl -s -X POST "$url" -H "X-HTTP-Method-Override: GET" -o /dev/null -w "$url override -> %{http_code}\n"
done

# bypass com encoded characters
curl -s "https://alvo.com/%2e%2e/admin"
curl -s "https://alvo.com/admin%20"
curl -s "https://alvo.com/admin;"

clairvoyance -o schema.json -w wordlist.txt https://alvo.com/graphql
clairvoyance -o schema.json -w wordlist.txt -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" https://alvo.com/graphql

curl -s https://alvo.com/openapi.json | jq '.paths | keys[]'
curl -s https://alvo.com/openapi.json | jq -r '.paths | to_entries[] | .key + " " + (.value | keys | join(","))'
# listar parametros de cada endpoint
curl -s https://alvo.com/openapi.json | jq '.paths | to_entries[] | {endpoint: .key, methods: .value}'

curl -H "X-Forwarded-Host: evil.com" https://alvo.com/page
curl -H "X-Original-URL: /admin" https://alvo.com/
curl -H "X-Forwarded-Scheme: http" https://alvo.com/page
warnings: [!warning] ffuf -ac (auto-calibrate) pode esconder findings reais em apps com resposta dinamica (CSRF tokens, timestamps no body). testar com e sem -ac
paragraphs: descobrir parametros aceitos, endpoints de api escondidos, e metodos http alternativos. onde achar input escondido que as ferramentas de dir fuzzing nao pegam.
parametros que mudam o comportamento (erro diferente, redirect, conteudo diferente) sao candidatos pra sqli, xss, lfi, ssrf.
[!warning] ffuf -ac (auto-calibrate) pode esconder findings reais em apps com resposta dinamica (CSRF tokens, timestamps no body). testar com e sem -ac
[!tip] arjun com -w burp-parameter-names.txt (wordlist maior que a default). default do arjun e pequena e perde params incomuns
PortSwigger extension. identifica params hidden com binary search ate 65536 nomes por request. util pra cache poisoning e header injection.
obter schema GraphQL mesmo com introspection desativada. usa field suggestion attack pra reconstruir o schema completo.
extrair endpoints nao documentados de specs expostas (swagger.json / openapi.json).
headers que podem virar cache keys e envenenar respostas servidas a outros usuarios.

classification.title: fuzzing de parametros & api discovery
classification.policy_note: parameter/endpoint fuzzing = L2 (high request volume); only when program allows automated testing
